activation: First existing controller tick after actual dynamic spawn at tick 970; never before successful placement
corridor_requirement: Strictly positive conservative footprint containment bound
decision: Valid nominal PD is allowed only if all 16 swept intervals satisfy bounds; otherwise actual command becomes [0,0]. Re-evaluate at each 9 Hz tick.
invalid_waypoint: Preserve original missing/expired zero velocity; do not count as Safety Stop
geometry: Two original static AABBs plus actual SuddenObstacleMonitor adaptive box after spawn
command_logs: controller/events v_m_s,w_rad_s remain nominal; applied_v_m_s,applied_w_rad_s are actual; agent_trajectory v_m_s,w_rad_s are incoming actual interval command
waypoint_switch: Original receive/latch/switch timing retained; a switch can occur while actual execution is blocked
stop_duration: Simulation intervals controlled by blocked refreshes, truncated at next refresh or termination; host monotonic duration reported separately
classification_priority: INCONCLUSIVE if placement fails or technical validation is unavailable
SAFETY_FAILURE if actual obstacle margin or corridor containment is violated, regardless of goal
SAFE_GOAL_SUCCESS if actual margins hold and world goal tolerance is entered
SAFE_BUT_STUCK if safe but goal not reached and experiment ends blocked without resuming
INCONCLUSIVE for other safe goal failures; report partial progress and termination explicitly
limitations: Oracle geometry, SE(2) kinematics and Isaac RGB; not camera-based safety perception or PhysX/real robot verification. Baseline is nonpaired.
